9c2b02dea3ad06a2.description: About the Role Fakeeh Care Group is seeking a Senior IT Analyst to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves supporting the Data Analytics function by extracting, analyzing, validating, and interpreting data to develop dashboards, reports, KPIs, visualizations, and actionable insights. The Senior IT Analyst will play a crucial role in supporting clinical, operational, and corporate decision-making across the group. Key Responsibilities Analyze and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights. Extract, clean, validate, and prepare data from approved sources for analysis and reporting. Develop, maintain, and update dashboards, reports, and data visualizations. Support KPI definition, calculation, validation, and performance reporting. Ensure data quality, accuracy, consistency, and reliability in reports, dashboards, and analytics outputs. Perform data validation, reconciliation, and issue follow-up with relevant stakeholders. Collaborate with clinical, operational, and corporate stakeholders to understand data requirements and reporting needs. Support data governance activities, including data definitions, standardization, and documentation of approved reporting logic. Conduct advanced analytics, statistical analysis, and modeling where applicable. Communicate analytical findings, insights, and recommendations to stakeholders in a clear and actionable manner. Document data sources, business rules, calculations, assumptions, and report specifications. Support testing and validation of new dashboards, reports, analytics products, and data integrations. Participate in data governance audits, compliance activities, and data quality improvement initiatives. Handle complex analyses with greater independence and engage directly with stakeholders to define requirements, validate outputs, and provide recommendations. Mentor junior analysts and support the delivery of assigned analytics initiatives. Continuous Improvement and Compliance Perform all duties in alignment with Fakeeh’s Person-Centered care values. Actively contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the scope of the role. Adhere to safety protocols and proactively address job-related safety concerns. Maintain strict confidentiality of all sensitive information. Comply with cybersecurity policies and standards, participating in awareness training to prevent cyber threats. Uphold Fakeeh Care’s code of conduct, policies, and ethical standards. Complete mandatory education requirements at least one month prior to expiration. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in data analytics or a similar IT role.

Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve software bugs and technical issues. Implement security standards and ensure the protection of user data. Collaborate effectively with UI/UX designers and back-end developers. Test applications to ensure compatibility across different devices and operating systems. Proficiency in Flutter and Dart or React Native. Demonstrated experience in developing applications for both iOS and Android platforms. Experience with REST APIs and Firebase. Knowledge of State Management principles. Experience in publishing applications on the App Store and Google Play. Proficiency in Git and version control systems. Good understanding of UI/UX principles specifically for mobile applications. Ability to optimize application performance and solve complex technical issues. Candidates must currently reside in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, to be considered for this role. Work Type This is a full-time employment opportunity within Elite Consultancy Company.

9caca0e54d5a1bd5.description: About the Role Carrier (KSA) is seeking an After Market Country Division Manager to lead and expand its Aftermarket business in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position, based in Riyadh, involves full responsibility for the division's Profit and Loss (P&L) performance. The role focuses on overseeing the entire aftermarket portfolio, including Service Modernization, Service Repair, Service Agreements, Parts, and Digital Service offerings, while leading sales and operations teams to achieve sustainable business growth. Role Context and Objectives The After Market Country Division Manager will develop and implement the country's aftermarket strategy, ensuring alignment with regional and global objectives. Key responsibilities include strengthening customer relationships, driving operational excellence through dealer collaboration, optimizing parts management, and leading digital transformation initiatives. This leadership position aims to enhance Carrier's market position and build high-performing teams within the aftermarket sector. Key Responsibilities Manage the Aftermarket Division's P&L, covering revenue, profitability, costs, margins, and cash flow, and execute strategies for sustainable growth. Lead the Service Modernization, Service Repair, Service Agreements, and Parts businesses, defining portfolio strategies, pricing, and customer value propositions. Direct service sales and operational teams to meet business targets, develop go-to-market strategies, and strengthen customer relationships and service contract penetration. Develop and implement the Parts go-to-market strategy in collaboration with dealers, focusing on inventory planning, availability, turns, and dealer performance. Lead digital service transformation, develop new digital offerings, and accelerate the adoption of predictive maintenance, remote monitoring, and digital solutions. Identify new business opportunities, strengthen strategic customer partnerships, and drive market share growth across the aftermarket portfolio. Build, lead, and develop high-performing Sales, Operations, Service, and Parts teams, strengthening organizational capabilities and fostering a performance-driven culture. Qualifications and Requirements Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical Engineering. Experience: 15+ years of relevant experience in Service, Aftermarket, or Industrial Operations, with over 10 years of overall experience. P&L Management: Proven experience in full P&L management and leadership of service sales and operations. Commercial & Operational Expertise: Strong commercial and operational experience, including service portfolio management, profitability, and parts business management. Strategy Development: Demonstrated experience in developing and executing business strategies and driving profitable growth. Dealer & Customer Management: Experience managing dealer networks and developing strong customer relationships. Leadership: Proven leadership capabilities, with experience building and developing high-performing teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience leading digital service transformation and implementing digital service solutions. Knowledge of predictive maintenance, remote monitoring, and connected service technologies. Experience developing parts go-to-market strategies, inventory optimization models, and dealer performance improvement initiatives. Experience working within a multinational organization and aligning local business strategies with regional and global objectives. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a multinational organization. The role requires leadership of diverse teams and collaboration with dealers and customers to achieve business objectives.

9c5c71fbabfffc59.job_title: HSSE Manager Al Futtaim Automotive BYD
9c5c71fbabfffc59.description: About the Role: HSSE Manager Al Futtaim Group is seeking an HSSE Manager to lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of Health, Safety, Security, and Environment programs for Al-Futtaim Automotive – BYD operations across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam, and requires 6-10 years of experience, with salary not disclosed. The HSSE Manager will ensure full compliance with KSA regulatory frameworks and align operational practices with Al-Futtaim Group HSSE governance standards, reporting to the Head of Government Relations & HSSE. Role Purpose and Scope The position holds direct accountability for protecting the workforce, customers, assets, and brand reputation across BYD showrooms, workshops, parts warehouses, and corporate sites in Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, and the wider KSA dealer network. This role is critical for enabling business growth by ensuring uninterrupted operations, securing all statutory certifications, and embedding a strong safety-first culture across the BYD KSA footprint. Key Responsibilities Drive hazard identification and gap reporting across all assigned BYD KSA sites through scheduled inspections, risk assessments, and field walkthroughs. Reduce preventable incidents through structured corrective and preventive action plans, tracking all findings to closure. Conduct full-cycle incident investigations for medium and high-severity events within 24 hours, documenting root-cause analysis. Maintain the Automotive Risk Register with up-to-date hazard observations, control measures, and residual risk ratings. Achieve and sustain a minimum 80% compliance score across all HSSE Compliance Audits for assigned sites. Ensure full alignment with KSA HSSE legislation, including Saudi Civil Defense, MHRSD, HCIS, SASO, and Environmental requirements. Secure and renew all statutory permits, including Civil Defense Safety Certificates, Environmental Clearance, and Municipal HSSE clearances. Stay current with KSA regulatory developments and proactively implement operational adjustments. Ensure zero notices of violation across all assigned sites and no pending high-risk audit recommendations beyond 90 days. Represent Al-Futtaim Automotive – BYD in regulatory inspections, OEM HSSE audits, and third-party assessments. Develop and maintain site-specific emergency response plans and supervise a minimum of two emergency evacuation drills per site per year. Ensure all sites comply with Civil Defense requirements for trained First Aiders and Fire Wardens. Maintain full operational readiness of fire alarm, suppression, and life-safety systems. Lead the HSSE response for major business events, product launches, and customer activations. Lead structured monthly Safety Committee meetings at every assigned site. Embed visible safety standards across all facilities, including signage, PPE compliance, and LOTO procedures. Champion continuous workforce awareness through toolbox talks, safety alerts, and structured campaigns. Develop and maintain Safe Work Procedures (SWPs) for all hazardous tasks, machinery, and operations. Lead BYD KSA operations through ISO 45001, ISO 14001, and other relevant international certifications. Maintain documented HSSE management systems aligned with Al-Futtaim Group standards and international benchmarks. Coordinate with internal compliance teams and external certification bodies for successful audits. Drive continuous improvement of HSSE policies, procedures, and standard operating practices. Lead, develop, and supervise HSSE Officers and the field HSSE team across the BYD KSA dealer network. Set clear performance objectives, conduct monthly performance reviews, and manage gaps through improvement frameworks. Build technical capability across the team through structured training and certification pathways. Maintain audit-ready records of team coverage, site visit frequency, and operational deployment. Drive Saudization of the HSSE function in line with MHRSD requirements. Deliver regular HSSE performance dashboards, audit summaries, and incident trend analysis to senior leadership. Partner with Aftersales, Sales, Logistics, Facilities, HR, and Government Relations leadership to integrate HSSE priorities. Provide executive-level visibility on HSSE risk exposure, mitigation progress, and statutory certification status. Support business strategy reviews with credible HSSE intelligence on regulatory shifts and operational risk. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Sciences, or a related discipline. Certifications: NEBOSH International General Certificate (IGC) is mandatory; NEBOSH International Diploma is strongly preferred. IOSH Managing Safely certification is mandatory. ISO 45001 / ISO 14001 Lead Auditor, OSHA 30, or NFPA equivalents are highly preferred. Experience: Minimum 6 to 12 years of progressive HSSE experience, including at least 3 to 5 years in a managerial capacity. Industry Exposure: Demonstrable experience in automotive retail, dealer operations, large-scale workshops, parts/logistics warehousing, or comparable multi-site industries. Regulatory Knowledge: Direct working exposure to KSA regulatory frameworks, including Saudi Civil Defense, MHRSD, HCIS (where applicable), SASO, and Environmental Authorities. Audit Experience: Proven track record of leading ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 certification and surveillance audits to successful outcomes. Technical Skills: Strong working knowledge of HSSE management systems, incident reporting platforms, and analytics tools. Mobility: Valid KSA driving license and willingness to travel across all KSA regions on a regular basis, including weekends when required. Work Environment This is a full-time position within Al Futtaim Group's automotive division, specifically supporting BYD operations across multiple sites in Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam. The role involves regular travel within KSA to ensure compliance and operational readiness across the dealer network.

9c28355ad7fa8fc4.description: About the Role Pico Play is seeking a Quality Assurance Quality Control Engineer to join their team in Al Kharj, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on ensuring that all themed attraction projects meet the highest standards of quality, safety, and compliance. The engineer will be responsible for developing and implementing QA/QC policies, conducting inspections, and managing quality documentation. Conduct audits, inspections, and tests to ensure compliance with project specifications, standards, and client requirements. Identify quality risks and implement corrective and preventive actions to address potential non-conformities. Maintain and manage QA/QC documentation, including inspection reports, material test results, and non-conformance reports. Prepare and present regular quality performance reports to management and clients. Ensure all project quality records are maintained and accessible for future reference. Collaboration and Communication Liaise with project managers, engineers, contractors, and suppliers to address quality concerns. Facilitate quality-related meetings, training sessions, and workshops. Work closely with procurement teams to ensure the quality of materials and equipment aligns with project requirements. Regulatory Compliance Ensure all projects adhere to relevant industry standards, safety regulations, and Pico Play's quality standards. Stay updated on changes in standards, codes, and practices applicable to themed attraction projects. 9cc22487c3ffbda2.description: About the Role Saudi Consulting Services - SAUD CONSULT is seeking an experienced Mechanical CAD Draftsman to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves preparing accurate mechanical and shop drawings for various building and construction projects, with a focus on HVAC, plumbing, and fire fighting systems, utilizing AutoCAD. Role Overview As a Mechanical CAD Draftsman, you will collaborate with mechanical engineers to translate designs and preliminary sketches into precise technical drawings. Your work will ensure compliance with approved specifications and industry codes. The position requires coordination with other engineering disciplines and the ability to update drawings based on feedback and site conditions. Key Responsibilities Prepare mechanical and shop drawings for buildings and projects using AutoCAD. Draft HVAC layouts, including duct and pipe routes. Develop plumbing and drainage drawings. Prepare fire fighting network drawings. Draft pump room and mechanical equipment layouts. Coordinate mechanical drawings with architectural, structural, and electrical drawings to identify and resolve clashes. Convert hand sketches and preliminary designs into accurate digital drawings. Prepare As-Built drawings based on site data and execution. Revise and update drawings according to feedback from engineers, consultants, and clients. Extract preliminary quantities for ducts, pipes, and equipment as required. Ensure compliance with approved codes and standards, such as SBC 501, SBC 701, and Civil Defense requirements. Organize and archive drawings and files in adherence to the document control system. Qualifications and Experience Diploma in Engineering Drafting, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent with proven practical experience. 2-5 years of experience in mechanical CAD drafting. Proficiency in AutoCAD. Ability to read and interpret mechanical and architectural drawings and technical specifications. Knowledge of mechanical symbols and principles of duct and pipe routing. Required Skills High accuracy and attention to detail. Ability to meet deadlines consistently. Strong teamwork and collaboration skills. Capability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to contribute to significant construction projects within a professional consulting environment.

9cc7f306b5203f9a.description: مطلوب للعمل بالدمام مسؤول / مسؤولة تسويق رقمي (Digital Marketing Specialist) ( سعودي / ة ) نبحث عن مسؤول / مسؤولة تسويق رقمي للانضمام إلى فريق عمل مترو ميد ، يمتلك مهارات إبداعية وقدرة على إدارة وتنفيذ الحملات التسويقية الرقمية وتحقيق أهداف النمو والانتشار. المهام والمسؤوليات: إعداد وتنفيذ الخطط والاستراتيجيات التسويقية الرقمية. إدارة حسابات التواصل الاجتماعي وإنتاج والإشراف على المحتوى. إعداد وإدارة الحملات الإعلانية المدفوعة على مختلف المنصات تحليل أداء الحملات ومتابعة مؤشرات الأداء (KPIs). إعداد التقارير الدورية وتقديم التوصيات لتحسين النتائج. متابعة المنافسين وتحليل السوق والفرص التسويقية. المتطلبات: خبرة عملية في مجال التسويق الرقمي. إجادة التعامل مع منصات التواصل الاجتماعي وأدوات إدارة الإعلانات. معرفة جيدة بتحليل البيانات وقياس الأداء. مهارات التخطيط والتنظيم وإدارة الوقت. الإبداع والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتحقيق الأهداف. 📩 للتقديم: يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية مع نماذج من الأعمال السابقة إلى البريد الألكتروني مع كتابة المسمى الوظيفي (Digital Marketing Specialist) في عنوان الرسالة.

9c522c4e016cbf12.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث فندق سوفيتيل جبل عمر عن مدير تدريب للانضمام إلى فريقه في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإشراف على تطوير وتنفيذ برامج التدريب، وضمان توافقها مع الأهداف الاستراتيجية للفندق. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على وضع الأهداف العامة والخطط الاستراتيجية للتدريب، وتطوير سياسات وإجراءات التدريب. تخطيط وتنظيم برامج التدريب بما يتوافق مع الخطط التشغيلية والأهداف الاستراتيجية المحددة. ضمان توافر الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لسير العمليات اليومية بكفاءة وفعالية. مراقبة توجهات وممارسات سوق العمل في مجال التدريب لضمان تقديم برامج تدريبية مناسبة وحديثة. الإشراف على وضع وتطبيق استراتيجيات وبرامج تطوير وتدريب الموظفين لضمان توافر الكوادر المؤهلة. بناء علاقات استراتيجية مع الشركاء الخارجيين وتنسيق المشاريع المشتركة لمواكبة المستجدات في مجال التدريب. ضمان وجود قنوات تواصل داخلية فعالة لتحقيق التكامل بين الوحدات التنظيمية ذات العلاقة. الإشراف على إعداد التقارير والملخصات حول إنجازات عمليات التدريب وتقييم فعاليتها وعرضها على الإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التدريب أو تطوير الموارد البشرية. القدرة على وضع الخطط الاستراتيجية والأهداف العامة للتدريب. فهم جيد لعمليات تطبيق خطط وبرامج ومناهج التدريب. مهارات في بناء العلاقات والتواصل الفعال مع الأطراف الداخلية والخارجية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية. القدرة على التخطيط والتنظيم. مهارات تحليلية لتقييم فعالية برامج التدريب. مهارات تواصل ممتازة، كتابية وشفوية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وفي بيئة ديناميكية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لضمان الإشراف المباشر على عمليات التدريب وتطويرها ضمن فندق سوفيتيل جبل عمر. معلومات إضافية لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. نشجع المرشحين المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.

9cb2253ce6730b97.description: About Cenomi Retail Founded in 1990, Cenomi Retail has introduced over 80 international retail and F&B brands to Saudi Arabia, including Zara, Mango, Aldo, Cinnabon, and Subway. The company operates more than 1,600 stores across 100 shopping centers in 11 countries, focusing on growth and unique brand partnerships. Role Overview Cenomi Retail is seeking a Brand Manager F&B to lead an assigned Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) brand as an end-to-end business. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 8-12 years of experience. The Brand Manager will ensure consistent brand standards, exceptional guest experience, disciplined operations, engaged teams, sustainable sales growth, and the achievement of approved profit and loss (P&L) plans. This role serves as the primary contact between Cenomi Retail and the Brand Principal/Franchisor, responsible for translating brand strategy into effective store-level execution across the market. Key Responsibilities Act as the primary point of contact for the Brand Principal/Franchisor on all business matters, including operations, training, product, quality, marketing, development, supply chain, and financial performance. Lead daily brand operations across all assigned restaurants, ensuring safe, efficient, and guest-focused execution. Own the brand P&L and deliver approved targets for sales, gross margin, restaurant contribution, EBITDA, and cash performance. Ensure consistent end-to-end guest journey across all channels and compliance with food safety, quality, service, and franchise operating standards. Manage the brand training agenda in partnership with Learning & Development and the Brand Principal, ensuring employee certification and capability development. Coordinate menu innovation, product trials, operational validation, and marketing campaign execution. Partner with Supply Chain to ensure product availability, approved sourcing, and inventory health. Develop and execute the annual brand business plan, translating company strategy into measurable priorities. Decision Rights and Accountability Recommend and execute actions to achieve the approved brand strategy, budget, and operating plan within delegated authority. Approve routine operating decisions and expenditure within the approved budget and delegation-of-authority limits. Stop or escalate any practice that creates a material food safety, people safety, legal, financial, reputational, or brand compliance risk. Remain accountable for brand results, proactively resolving dependencies and escalating unresolved risks. Key Performance Indicators Financial: Net sales growth, budget accuracy, gross margin, restaurant contribution/EBITDA, food and labor costs. Commercial: Transactions/traffic, average transaction value (ATV), product mix, delivery sales, new product performance. Guest: Guest rating/NPS, complaint rate, order accuracy, speed of service. Operational: Brand audit/OER score, food safety score, quality, service, cleanliness, equipment uptime. People & Training: Training completion, manager bench strength, employee turnover, engagement, safety performance. Brand Partnership: Quality of reporting, closure of Brand Principal actions, compliance with franchise standards. Working Relationships The Brand Manager will collaborate internally with Operations leadership, Finance, HR, Marketing, Supply Chain, and other departments. External relationships include the Brand Principal/Franchisor, suppliers, delivery aggregators, landlords, consultants, auditors, and regulatory authorities.

9cf51c610297780c.description: About the Role: Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) Aroma City Group is seeking an accomplished Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) to lead its commercial strategy and drive sustainable revenue growth. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and is open to Saudi Nationals. The CCO will report directly to the CEO and will be responsible for business development, sales pipeline performance, strategic partnerships, and client retention across key market sectors. Key Responsibilities Design and execute end-to-end commercial strategies to achieve target revenues, maximize profitability, and expand market share. Lead strategic business development, client acquisition, enterprise account management, and high-value tender/deal negotiations. Establish robust commercial KPIs, pipeline tracking, revenue forecasting, and pricing models to safeguard cash flow and margin health. Partner with the CEO, Board, and cross-functional leadership (Finance, Legal, Operations) to align commercial targets with corporate governance and budget frameworks. 9c692c64b0956ea2.description: About the Role KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology) is seeking an SAP Functional Analyst specializing in SAP S/4HANA Sales and Order to Cash. This full-time position is located in Thuwal, Makkah, and involves shaping the university's end-to-end sales, contracting, fulfillment, billing, and revenue processes. The role focuses on setting functional direction, simplifying legacy practices, and translating institutional needs into scalable solutions on KAUST’s SAP platform. Role Context and Impact The SAP Functional Analyst will lead a prioritized functional roadmap, promoting fit-to-standard and clean-core design principles. This position involves collaboration with business process owners, enterprise architecture, and delivery teams on integration, data, user experience, and change management. The analyst will evaluate SAP Fiori, workflow, analytics, SAP Business Technology Platform, and Business AI capabilities to address defined business problems and measure outcomes through process performance, adoption, and controls. Key Responsibilities Own the functional roadmap for Sales and Order to Cash, ensuring alignment with KAUST strategy, business process owners, enterprise architecture, and SAP platform plans. Lead end-to-end process design across inquiries, quotations, contracts, sales orders, fulfillment, pricing, billing, receivables, and revenue recognition, adapting standard capabilities to KAUST’s research, education, and commercial activities as justified. Facilitate fit-to-standard decisions with stakeholders, challenging duplicate steps and unnecessary customization, documenting material deviations, and recommending upgrade-safe options under clean-core principles. Define business requirements and functional design for integration with Finance, Materials Management, Grants Management, revenue accounting, credit management, point-of-sale, and relevant non-SAP platforms, adhering to KAUST’s approved architecture. Partner with data owners to enhance customer, product, pricing, contract, and transaction data quality, including ownership, controls, and reporting definitions. Guide the design of role-based SAP Fiori experiences, approvals, workflow, and embedded analytics, involving users early and measuring the impact on task efficiency and reliability. Assess automation and SAP Business AI or Joule use cases based on value, data protection, human oversight, and platform readiness before recommending adoption. Provide functional leadership in transformation initiatives, including solution evaluation, delivery assurance, business acceptance, cutover readiness, and post-implementation benefits tracking; direct specialist configuration and testing through delivery teams. Advise on controls, segregation of duties, and auditability within the order-to-cash process in collaboration with Finance, Information Security, and risk owners. Maintain relationships with business leaders, SAP partners, and internal technology teams, translating complex options into clear decisions, trade-offs, costs, and measurable outcomes. Required Experience and Skills 5-10 years of experience in a relevant SAP functional role. Ability to work under general direction with substantial autonomy, owning a functional roadmap and prioritized outcomes while escalating material investment, architecture, and policy decisions through established governance. Demonstrated ability to build consensus across Finance, research, commercial, and technology stakeholders, influencing process owners and delivery partners without relying on formal line authority. Proficiency in resolving complex cross-functional process and integration issues, balancing standard SAP capability, university-specific needs, controls, data quality, and long-term maintainability. Strong facilitation, analytical, communication, and change leadership skills. Capability to establish measures of process performance, write clear decision recommendations, manage competing priorities, and coach colleagues in modern SAP ways of working. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Thuwal, Makkah, within the dynamic environment of KAUST. The role requires collaboration across various university departments and external partners. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry. Salary for this position is not disclosed.

9c43f3e0780c5d57.description: About the Role Acuative Middle East is seeking a Senior Security Architect to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role is central to ensuring security is integrated into IT projects from initiation to go-live, applying the organization's Secure by Design (SbD) framework. The Senior Security Architect acts as the primary security subject matter expert and point of contact for project leads, solution architects, and project managers. Key Responsibilities Act as the security SME for assigned projects across all SbD phases: initiation, service profiling, design, build, assurance, and go-live approval. Engage with project proponents to explain the SbD process, assist with requests, and complete service profiling to determine project risk levels. Define security requirements based on the controls matrix, requirements catalog, applicable policies, and regulations. Review high-level and low-level designs for security alignment and architecture principles, addressing and tracking design issues. Conduct threat modeling for new or significantly altered solutions. Perform security architecture assurance to confirm built solutions match endorsed designs and all required controls are in place. Provide security endorsement at project gates (*, procurement, infrastructure build, go-live) and maintain decision evidence. Coordinate with Information Security teams (Privacy, SOC, Vulnerability Management, Cyber Assurance) to gather inputs, relay them to projects, and ensure timely delivery of outputs. Run cyber risk assessments for projects, consolidating findings from design reviews, threat models, scans, assurance checks, and penetration tests. Record findings in the risk register with ratings, recommended controls, risk owners, and treatment plans, presenting risks to stakeholders for formal acceptance or treatment. Maintain and improve security architecture practice assets, including templates, controls matrix, and the reusable security requirements catalog. Develop and maintain reusable security architecture patterns, such as SaaS and SSO integration with Microsoft Entra ID. Map controls to regulatory requirements (NCA ECC, CCC, PDPL) and the organization's security roadmap, identifying and proposing improvements to the SbD framework. Review changes submitted to the Change Advisory Board (CAB) for security impact and alignment with architecture standards. Prepare security requirements for RFPs, vendor security questions, and evaluate security sections of vendor proposals and contracts. Mentorship and Quality Assurance This role involves mentoring other Security Architects on SbD delivery, risk assessment, and stakeholder engagement. Responsibilities include reviewing deliverables such as requirements, design reviews, assurance evidence, and risk entries before issuance. The Senior Security Architect also serves as an escalation point for complex, high-risk, or disputed projects. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in security architecture or a related field. Demonstrated expertise in applying Secure by Design (SbD) principles. Strong understanding of security controls, risk assessment methodologies, and regulatory compliance (NCA ECC, CCC, PDPL). Experience with threat modeling, vulnerability management, and penetration testing coordination. Proficiency in reviewing technical designs (HLD, LLD) for security implications. Ability to coordinate effectively with various information security teams and project stakeholders. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, covering operations in Jeddah and Makkah. The role requires collaboration with diverse IT and information security teams within Acuative Middle East.

9c932ffe163990e0.description: Job Title: Fraud Operations Lead We are seeking an experienced Fraud Operations Lead with a strong background in fraud prevention and operations, preferably within the Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL), digital lending, or installment finance sector. The role focuses on managing fraud detection, monitoring suspicious activities, optimizing fraud controls, and ensuring compliance with SAMA regulations across BNPL customer and merchant journeys. Key Responsibilities Manage daily fraud monitoring, detection, and investigations across BNPL customer and merchant activities, ensuring operational SLAs and investigation quality. Conduct complex fraud investigations, root cause analysis, and incident escalations. Configure, test, and optimize fraud detection rules, decisioning systems, and machine learning (ML) models. Analyze transaction patterns, device intelligence, identity signals, and customer behavior to identify emerging fraud risks. Monitor fraud trends and recommend preventive measures to minimize fraud losses and improve detection effectiveness. Prepare fraud reports and dashboards covering fraud losses, talse positives, investigation outcomes, and operational KPIs. Ensure compliance with the SAMA Counter-Fraud Framework, including regulatory reporting, requests, and quarterly meetings. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to implement fraud control improvements and strengthen fraud prevention processes. Qualifications & Requirements Bachelor's degree in finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Business Administration, or a related field. Minimum 3-5 years of experience in fraud prevention, fraud operations, or fraud investigations. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on fraud experience in BNPL, digital lending, or installment finance. Hands-on experience with fraud decisioning platforms, case management systems, and fraud rule configuration. Knowledge of ML model monitoring, fraud investigations, and incident escalation. Familiarity with the SAMA Counter-Fraud Framework and regulatory requirements. Saudi nationality is mandatory. Preferred Qualifications Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) certification. SQL knowledge for data analysis and reporting. Experience with financial institutions, payment companies, or e-commerce plattorms.

9c16ac7b34500293.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة ايوان للمقاولات عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، تقدير المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ الأعمال، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بالتعليمات الإدارية وأداء العمل بدقة وكفاءة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية للمشاريع المنزلية، الصناعية، والتجارية ومكوناتها. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية المطلوبة وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع التأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، ومراقبة تشغيل الدارات الكهربائية، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية بدقة. معرفة قوية بأنظمة السلامة والصحة المهنية المتعلقة بالعمل الكهربائي. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

9c896dc628b86b29.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة درة ليان لطب وتقويم الاسنان عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تقديم رعاية أسنان شاملة للمرضى، بدءاً من التشخيص وحتى تنفيذ الخطط العلاجية ومتابعتها. تتطلب الوظيفة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، وهي بدوام كامل. الهدف من الدور يهدف هذا الدور إلى تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة، ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة، وتنفيذ مجموعة واسعة من المعالجات السنية. يشمل ذلك متابعة تجهيز وتركيب التعويضات السنية، ومعالجة أمراض اللثة، وإجراء الجراحات الفموية الصغرى، بالإضافة إلى توثيق جميع الإجراءات الطبية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص السريري للأسنان، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة وتحليلها، وتشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان، ثم إعداد خطة العلاج والبرنامج الزمني الخاص بها. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات السنية، ومعالجة القنوات اللبية، وتنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة، وإجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى. وصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة للحالات المرضية المختلفة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرات درجة البكالوريوس في طب الأسنان أو ما يعادلها. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة. مهارات جيدة في التواصل مع المرضى وتقديم الرعاية اللازمة. بيئة العمل يعمل طبيب الأسنان العام في عيادة شركة درة ليان لطب وتقويم الاسنان بالرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى التقديم لهذه الوظيفة في الرياض. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

9cb4d91e42d8fe18.description: About the Role Khidmah is seeking an Occupational Health & Safety (OH&S) Officer to join its team in Abqaiq, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves implementing and overseeing site safety management systems to ensure compliance with KSA regulations and international ISO standards. The OH&S Officer will focus on creating and maintaining a zero-harm environment across all site operations. Key Responsibilities Maintain site HSE documentation, hazard assessments (HIRA), and environmental plans in adherence to ISO standards (9001, 14001, 50001, 45001) and local legal requirements. Review and approve method statements, risk assessments, emergency plans, and work permits. Conduct regular safety audits, facility checks, hygiene evaluations, and enforce Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) usage. 9cbb72af1ab196f6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة عن مساعد إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يمثل هذا الدور نقطة تنسيق رئيسية لضمان جدولة وتسليم طلبات الخرسانة الجاهزة بدقة وفقاً لمتطلبات العملاء، ويعمل بدوام كامل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المساعد الإداري مسؤولية استلام وتسجيل وتنسيق ومتابعة طلبات العملاء وحجوزات توريد الخرسانة. كما يقوم بالتنسيق الفعال بين العملاء، أقسام المبيعات، عمليات المصنع، قسم التوزيع، مراقبة الجودة، النقل، والإدارات الأخرى ذات الصلة. المهام اليومية إدارة طلبات العملاء وحجوزاتهم. جدولة وتنسيق عمليات التسليم. المتابعة مع أقسام التوزيع والنقل والتسليم. تقديم خدمة العملاء ومعالجة المشكلات. إدارة التغييرات والإلغاءات والتنسيق التشغيلي. إعداد السجلات والتقارير وتنفيذ الأعمال الإدارية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التنسيق الفعال بين الأطراف المتعددة. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية قوية. بيئة العمل يعمل المساعد الإداري ضمن فريق شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب التنسيق المستمر والتعامل مع مختلف الأقسام والعملاء. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وسيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

9cd67d0e72765e33.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الفلاح للمقاولات عن مهندس طرق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في الدوادمي. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال هندسة الطرق. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بإجراء الدراسات الفنية، وتصميم مشاريع الطرق، ومتابعة التنفيذ لضمان مطابقة المواصفات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة الصور الجوية والمخططات الطبوغرافية والتقارير المائية والجيولوجية والبيئية المتعلقة بمشاريع الطرق. تحليل بدائل المسارات واختيار المسار الأنسب للطريق. إعداد التصاميم الأولية لمشاريع الطرق، بما في ذلك تحديد مواقع الجسور والعبارات والجدران الاستنادية. دراسة المواد المتوفرة، وتحديد خصائصها، واختيار الأنسب منها لطبقات الرصف. تصميم طبقات الرصف، وتحديد أنواعها، وسماكتها، ومكوناتها. متابعة تنفيذ مشاريع الطرق لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية والمعايير المعتمدة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال ونسب تقدم المشاريع الهندسية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال هندسة الطرق. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال هندسة وتصميم الطرق. معرفة قوية بأساليب الدراسات الفنية لمشاريع الطرق. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية. فهم جيد لمواصفات مواد الرصف وتصميم الطبقات. القدرة على متابعة تنفيذ المشاريع وضمان الجودة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على اتخاذ القرارات الفنية. إتقان استخدام برامج التصميم الهندسي ذات الصلة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لإعداد وعرض التقارير الفنية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والالتزام بالجداول الزمنية للمشاريع. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدوادمي بالرياض، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على تنفيذ مشاريع البنية التحتية. سيعمل المهندس ضمن فريق متخصص يسعى لتحقيق أعلى معايير الجودة والكفاءة في مشاريع الطرق. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة الفلاح للمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم مع السيرة الذاتية. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لتحديد الخطوات التالية.

9cdbfd2b07ef8782.description: About Almarai Founded in 1977, Almarai Company is recognized as the world’s largest vertically integrated dairy company and a leading food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company in the MENA region. Edit invoices as required by customers for new or disconnected links. Issue credit notes for cancellation orders after invoice posting, ensuring proper approval from higher management. 9c6ac5fd896fb38f.description: About the Role Jazeera Paints is seeking a Showroom Sales Representative for a full-time position. This role focuses on providing excellent customer service within the showroom, ensuring customer needs are met from initial inquiry through to product delivery and after-sales support. The representative will be responsible for maintaining high service standards and achieving sales targets. Key Responsibilities Guide customers through the showroom, introducing them to products and assisting with color and product coordination to secure orders. Calculate required quantities, issue invoices, and coordinate product delivery with showroom staff, assistants, workers, and drivers. Maintain the showroom's organization and cleanliness, ensuring all marketing tools like brochures and catalogs are available. Achieve sales targets as outlined in the sales plan and meet established Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Process online customer requests and update the e-commerce platform, considering item availability and stock levels. Manage stock levels by placing orders from warehouses according to minimum and maximum thresholds, adhering to a first-in, first-out policy to prevent dead stock. Report any missing products in the main store to the direct manager. Ensure goods in warehouses are arranged according to policy to maintain accurate stock records and facilitate periodic inventory checks. 9c89ed4434e8e0b6.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في الأحساء، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان صيانة المباني والمرافق بكفاءة، مع التركيز على الأعمال الدورية والطارئة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطة الصيانة الدورية لمختلف الأبنية وتحديد العيوب الفنية، ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قوائم بالمواد اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى تحديد الأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لإنجاز المهام. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، والتحقق من مطابقة الأعمال المنفذة للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. توضيح تفاصيل المخططات للفرق العاملة، ومتابعة دوامهم، ورفع تقارير دورية عن الأعمال المنجزة. قياس الأعمال المنجزة، وحساب كمياتها وتدقيقها، وإعداد المطالبات المالية بالتنسيق مع محاسب الكميات، وتسليم الأعمال لجهة الإشراف. تنفيذ أعمال النجارة وصيانة الأثاث. نطاق العمل سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن مشروع نظافة وصيانة وتشغيل مدينة سكنية في الربع الخالي، مما يتطلب القدرة على العمل في بيئات متنوعة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال صيانة المباني أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية. مهارات جيدة في التواصل وإعداد التقارير. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتقدم فرصة للمرشحين الطموحين لتطوير مهاراتهم في مجال صيانة المباني ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

9ce5eea3e72864ba.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking a Lead Commissioning Superintendent, Instrumentation. This full-time role involves overseeing the planning, coordination, execution, testing, calibration, integration, commissioning, and handover of instrumentation and control systems for new-build offshore jack-up drilling rigs. The objective is to ensure safe and reliable system operation, compliance with regulatory and class requirements, operational readiness, and successful project delivery and client acceptance. Key Responsibilities Lead the development and implementation of instrumentation commissioning plans, procedures, inspection and test plans (ITPs), method statements, schedules, and resource requirements to ensure efficient execution and achievement of commissioning milestones. Direct the commissioning, testing, calibration, verification, and startup of instrumentation systems, including pressure, temperature, flow, level, vibration monitoring, and associated field devices, to ensure operational reliability and compliance with design requirements. Lead the functional testing, integration, and performance verification of control valves, actuators, Fire & Gas systems, ESD/SIS loops, and critical safety instrumented functions to ensure safe and dependable facility operations. Oversee loop checks, calibration activities, functional testing, energization, FATs, SATs, and system performance verification to confirm instrument integrity, control functionality, and readiness for operation. Manage commissioning interfaces among engineering, construction, operations, OEM vendors, client representatives, and classification societies to facilitate technical resolution, commissioning readiness, and seamless system integration. Oversee the commissioning and integration of drilling instrumentation, HVAC/BMS controls, monitoring systems, and auxiliary instrumentation packages to ensure optimum system performance and operational effectiveness. Direct commissioning activities in accordance with project specifications, API, IEC, classification society requirements, and quality standards to ensure full compliance and successful certification. Promote and enforce compliance with permit-to-work systems, SIMOPS requirements, risk assessments, toolbox talks, and project HSE procedures to maintain a safe commissioning and energization environment. Oversee the preparation, review, and closeout of commissioning documentation, including check sheets, loop folders, test reports, red-line markups, vendor reports, ITRs, MC/RFCC/RFOC certificates, and handover dossiers to ensure documentation completeness and traceability. Direct punch-list management, construction-to-commissioning transitions, readiness assessments, as-built documentation, O&M manual development, and final handover activities to ensure operational readiness and successful project completion. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Instrumentation Engineering, Electrical & Instrumentation, or an equivalent technical discipline. Experience: A minimum of 12-15 years of experience in instrumentation commissioning is required, with at least 8 years specifically in offshore rigs, ideally involving new-build jack-up rigs. Work Type This is a full-time position. Salary Salary information for this role is not disclosed.

9cece20566ec4e00.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة شلفا لإدارة المرافق عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات التدفئة ومضخاتها ومكيفات الهواء. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة بشكل كامل، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتعلقة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف لضمان دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. القدرة على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. معرفة جيدة بمعايير الجودة والمواد المستخدمة في هذه الأنظمة. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف في شركة شلفا لإدارة المرافق ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية في مدينة ينبع بالمدينة المنورة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم خدمات عالية الجودة في مجال إدارة المرافق. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة شلفا لإدارة المرافق.

9caf7cf111ad2515.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث ألفا العناية الطبية عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تشخيص وعلاج أمراض الفم والأسنان، وتقديم رعاية شاملة للمرضى. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحوصات الشاملة للأسنان، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة وتحليلها لتشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة. وضع خطط علاجية متكاملة وبرامج زمنية مناسبة لحالات المرضى. تطبيق الحشوات ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان، وتنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المرضى من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة، وإجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى. وصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة للحالات المرضية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وتقديم الرعاية اللازمة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق ألفا العناية الطبية الذي يلتزم بتقديم أعلى مستويات الرعاية الصحية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف.

9c00c6388d72a65e.description: Job Summary InnovationTeam is looking for a motivated Saudi National at the beginning of their career to join the Sales & Business Development team. The role is designed as a development opportunity for a fresh or early-career professional who will be trained on InnovationTeam’s sales process, technology portfolio, CRM practices, proposal preparation and customer coordination. The primary focus of the role is sales process coordination and structured support to the sales team, including CRM reporting, meeting documentation, presentations, proposals, follow-ups and internal coordination. Over time, the employee will gain exposure to enterprise technology sales across AI, Cloud, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Applications, API & Integration and other InnovationTeam solutions. Key Responsibilities · Support the day-to-day coordination of sales opportunities and activities under the guidance of senior Sales and Business Development team members. · Update and maintain CRM records, customer information, opportunity stages, follow-up dates, sales activities and pipeline data accurately and on time. · Prepare regular CRM and sales reports, including pipeline status, pending actions, opportunity updates and management summaries. · Coordinate customer meetings, internal sales meetings, discovery sessions, presentations and solution demonstrations. · Prepare meeting agendas where required, capture Minutes of Meeting (MoM), document key decisions, action items, owners and deadlines, and follow up for closure. · Support the preparation and formatting of customer presentations, proposals, quotations, commercial offers, capability documents and other sales materials. · Coordinate with Presales, Technical, Delivery, Finance, Legal, Partner Management and other internal teams to collect the information required for proposals and customer responses. · Maintain proper sales documentation and organize proposals, quotations, customer communications, meeting records and opportunity-related files. · Assist with RFP, RFQ and tender coordination, including document collection, internal follow-up, submission tracking and deadline management. · Support customer and prospect follow-ups through email, telephone and scheduled meetings as directed by the Sales team. · Conduct basic customer, account, industry and market research to support sales planning and opportunity development. · Support technology partner and vendor coordination activities where required. · Learn InnovationTeam’s technology services and solutions and gradually develop the ability to communicate their business value to customers. · Provide administrative and coordination support to ensure the sales process progresses efficiently from opportunity creation through proposal, follow-up and closure. Required Qualifications · Saudi National – mandatory. · Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline. · 6 months to 1+ years of work experience in sales coordination, business support, administration, customer service, business development or a similar role. Relevant internship or trainee experience may also be considered. · Strong interest in building a career within B2B technology sales and digital transformation. · Good written and verbal communication skills in Arabic and English. · Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Excel, Word and Outlook. · Good documentation, organization and follow-up skills. · Ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines and stakeholders in a structured manner. · Willingness to learn CRM tools, enterprise sales processes and InnovationTeam’s technology portfolio. Preferred Skills · Exposure to CRM or sales pipeline tools. · Experience preparing presentations, reports, meeting minutes or business documents. · Basic understanding of cloud computing, AI, software solutions or digital transformation is an advantage, but not mandatory. · Previous internship or trainee experience in an IT, consulting, technology or B2B services company is preferred. · Basic understanding of the Saudi government and enterprise business environment is an advantage. Training & Development The selected candidate will receive practical exposure and on-the-job training in InnovationTeam’s sales process, CRM management, enterprise customer engagement, proposal preparation, technology solutions and cross-functional coordination. The objective is to develop the employee progressively from a sales coordination role into a customer-facing technology sales professional. Career Growth Junior Sales Executive / Sales Coordination Executive → Sales Executive → Account Manager → Senior Account Manager / Business Development Manager

9ce82c32d37bf710.description: Lucidya is a leading AI-powered Customer Experience Management (CXM) platform in the MENA region, enabling enterprises to understand, engage, and serve their customers across digital channels at scale. As we continue to scale our platform and move toward IPO-scale engineering, we are looking for a Frontend Software Engineer who is passionate about building high-quality user experiences, learning quickly, and using modern engineering practices — including AI — to deliver better software faster. This role is ideal for an engineer with 0–2 years of professional experience who has a solid foundation in frontend development and wants to grow in an environment where ownership, speed, quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement matter. We don't measure impact by how many lines of code you write. We care about your ability to understand problems, build maintainable solutions, collaborate effectively, and continuously improve the way you work. Please note that this position is strictly open to Saudi nationals only. Applications from non-Saudi nationals will not be considered and will be disqualified from the recruitment process. What You Will Work On Modern Frontend Development Build and maintain production-grade web applications using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript . Develop reusable, maintainable, and scalable frontend components. Turn product requirements and designs into clean, intuitive, and responsive user experiences. Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs and real-time communication services . Work with WebSockets / Socket.IO to build real-time user experiences. Understand and work with event-driven flows connected to RabbitMQ and backend messaging systems. Handle real-time updates, reconnection scenarios, error states, and synchronization between live events and UI state. Manage server state efficiently using React Query / TanStack Query . Manage complex client-side state using Redux / Redux Toolkit when appropriate. Contribute to improving frontend architecture, performance, code organization, and maintainability. Quality & Testing Quality is part of development — not something that happens after development. Write reliable unit and integration tests using Jest . Build and maintain end-to-end tests using Playwright . Test your work thoroughly before considering it complete. Participate actively in code reviews and learn from feedback. Identify regressions, edge cases, and potential production issues before they reach users. Debug issues systematically and focus on root causes rather than temporary workarounds. Write code that is easy for other engineers to understand, review, test, and maintain. AI-Enabled Engineering We expect engineers to use AI as an engineering accelerator , not as a replacement for engineering judgment. Use AI coding tools effectively to research, prototype, implement, debug, test, and refactor solutions faster. Know how to provide AI tools with the right context, requirements, and constraints to generate useful results. Critically review and validate AI-generated code instead of accepting it blindly. Use AI to automate repetitive work and spend more time solving meaningful engineering problems. Continuously explore better AI-assisted workflows that improve productivity and engineering velocity. Maintain high standards for quality, security, performance, and maintainability , regardless of whether code was written manually or with AI assistance. The goal isn't simply to write code faster. It's to deliver better outcomes in less time without sacrificing quality . Ownership & Collaboration Take ownership of your work from understanding the requirement through implementation, testing, review, and production. Communicate clearly when requirements are unclear or when you identify technical risks. Collaborate closely with frontend engineers, backend engineers, QA, product managers, and designers. Ask questions when necessary while developing the ability to investigate and unblock yourself. Give and receive constructive feedback during code reviews and technical discussions. Help teammates when needed and actively share what you learn. Take responsibility for the quality of what you ship. Treat the product as something you own — not simply a collection of assigned tickets. Stack Our frontend ecosystem includes: React JavaScript (ES6+) TypeScript React Query / TanStack Query Redux / Redux Toolkit Jest Playwright WebSockets / Socket.IO RabbitMQ REST APIs Git Modern AI-assisted development tools Experience with every technology is not required, but you should have strong fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly. What We Are Looking For Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely related field. 0–2 years of professional frontend development experience. Strong understanding of JavaScript fundamentals . Hands-on experience building applications with React . Good understanding of TypeScript and type-safe development. Good understanding of React fundamentals, including components, hooks, state management, rendering, and component lifecycle. Experience integrating frontend applications with APIs and handling asynchronous data. Familiarity with React Query / TanStack Query and Redux / Redux Toolkit . Understanding of frontend testing and experience with tools such as Jest and Playwright . Familiarity with real-time frontend architectures using WebSockets / Socket.IO . Basic understanding of message queues and event-driven systems , especially RabbitMQ . Understanding of common real-time challenges such as reconnection, duplicate events, stale data, race conditions, and keeping UI state synchronized. Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, responsive design, and browser fundamentals . Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows. Ability to debug problems rather than only work around them. Ability to write clean, readable, and maintainable code. Practical experience using AI tools to improve software engineering productivity . Strong willingness to learn and continuously improve. Good communication and teamwork skills. This Role Is a Strong Fit If You... Can take a feature from requirement to production instead of stopping when the code simply "works." Care about both speed and quality — you don't believe one has to come at the expense of the other. Use AI to multiply your productivity while still understanding and owning every solution you ship. Don't blindly copy AI-generated code — you question it, review it, test it, and improve it. Try to understand why something works, not only how to make it work. Investigate bugs and edge cases instead of immediately passing them to someone else. Treat testing as part of development rather than an optional final step. Care about code readability, scalability, and maintainability. Can receive code-review feedback and use it to improve. Communicate early when you are blocked. Enjoy collaborating and sharing knowledge with other engineers. Are curious about the product, not just the ticket assigned to you. Look for opportunities to improve existing code and engineering processes. Have a strong sense of ownership and don't need constant follow-up to get things done. Want to become a significantly stronger engineer over the next few years. What Success Looks Like Within your first months at Lucidya, we expect you to: Understand the frontend codebase, architecture, and development workflow. Deliver production features with increasing independence. Write clean and maintainable code that requires fewer review iterations over time. Build appropriate automated tests for the features you develop. Work confidently with REST APIs and increasingly understand our real-time architecture. Debug frontend and integration issues effectively. Use AI tools to noticeably improve your development speed and productivity while maintaining engineering quality . Participate meaningfully in technical discussions and code reviews. Collaborate effectively with your squad and other engineering

9c3dd525f3f83ff6.description: Eram Talent, a leading Talent Acquisition Company and a division of ERAM Holdings, is looking for a motivated Procurement & ERP Analyst to join our team within the IT Business Solutions sector. We specialize in connecting top-tier talent with exceptional opportunities across various industries, and we are committed to delivering innovative solutions to our clients. The Procurement & ERP Analyst for IT Business Solutions is responsible for supporting the procurement process for IT solutions and services within the client. This role will collaborate with stakeholders in Procurement to understand their IT solution needs and requirements. Key Responsibilities: Analyze user behaviour, needs, and feedback to identify opportunities for improving the user experience within the e-marketplace; collaborate with UX/UI designers to enhance the platform's usability, navigation, and overall user interface. Conduct user testing and gather user feedback to drive iterative improvements to the e-marketplace. Implement processes for onboarding new vendors and sellers onto the emarketplace platform; manage vendor profiles, product listings, and catalogues on the e-marketplace, ensuring accurate and up-to-date information. Collaborate with procurement teams to ensure compliance with vendor qualification criteria, contracts, and policies. Monitor and analyze key performance metrics of the emarketplace, such as transaction volume, conversion rates, user engagement, and revenue; identify trends, patterns, and areas for improvement based on performance data. Generate regular reports and dashboards to communicate the emarketplace's performance to stakeholders such as the IT Business Solutions Manager. Collaborate with IT security teams to implement and maintain appropriate security measures for the e-marketplace platform. Ensure compliance with local Saudi data protection regulations, privacy policies, and industry standards. Coordinate the allocation of IT resources, such as hardware, software, network capacity, and personnel, to meet demand requirements; develop resource allocation plans, considering factors such as project priorities, resource availability, and business needs. Monitor and analyze the capacity of IT infrastructure and systems, such as servers, storage, networks, and cloud resources; anticipate future capacity needs based on demand forecasts and growth projections for the Procurement function. Manage the inventory of IT solutions, licenses, and assets to ensure their availability and optimal utilization; collaborate with procurement and finance teams to track and manage IT solution inventory levels, cost, and lifecycle. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, supply chain management, procurement or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is required Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) or any procurement-related/other relevant certification preferred At least 5 years of experience in procurement analysis or ERP system management. Strong understanding of procurement processes and ERP functionality (preferably SAP, Oracle, or similar). Excellent analytical skills, with proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools.
